lines.en: Only the sons of Aaron will rule in justice and abundance. And upon their mouths the lot will go out for all the men of the assembly.

lines.en: Upon all who rebel against His way, I will not repent in the midst of the afflicted until their way is complete. And I will not keep wickedness in my heart. And he will not hear in his mouth.
